---
title: "Serial monitor"
subtitle: "Tools"
toc: false
---

Connects to a serial device over USB using the Web Serial API and shows incoming data live, with a line to send data back — the same job as the Arduino IDE's serial monitor or a terminal program like screen/PuTTY, without leaving the browser.

```{=html}
<div class="browser-note" id="browser-support-note">
Checking browser support…
</div>

<div class="tool-panel">
  <div class="tool-row">
    <span class="status-pill" id="status-pill"><span class="status-dot"></span><span id="status-text">Disconnected</span></span>
    <label for="baud-select">Baud</label>
    <select id="baud-select">
      <option>300</option>
      <option>1200</option>
      <option>2400</option>
      <option>4800</option>
      <option>9600</option>
      <option selected>115200</option>
      <option>230400</option>
      <option>460800</option>
      <option>921600</option>
    </select>
    <button class="tool-btn" id="connect-btn">Connect</button>
    <button class="tool-btn" id="disconnect-btn" disabled>Disconnect</button>
    <button class="tool-btn" id="clear-btn">Clear</button>
    <label><input type="checkbox" id="autoscroll-check" checked> Autoscroll</label>
    <label><input type="checkbox" id="timestamp-check"> Timestamps</label>
  </div>

  <div class="terminal" id="terminal"></div>

  <div class="tool-row">
    <input type="text" id="send-input" placeholder="Type a line to send" disabled>
    <select id="line-ending">
      <option value="\n" selected>\n</option>
      <option value="\r\n">\r\n</option>
      <option value="\r">\r</option>
      <option value="">none</option>
    </select>
    <button class="tool-btn" id="send-btn" disabled>Send</button>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  var terminalEl = document.getElementById("terminal");
  var statusPill = document.getElementById("status-pill");
  var statusText = document.getElementById("status-text");
  var connectBtn = document.getElementById("connect-btn");
  var disconnectBtn = document.getElementById("disconnect-btn");
  var clearBtn = document.getElementById("clear-btn");
  var sendInput = document.getElementById("send-input");
  var sendBtn = document.getElementById("send-btn");
  var baudSelect = document.getElementById("baud-select");
  var lineEndingSelect = document.getElementById("line-ending");
  var autoscrollCheck = document.getElementById("autoscroll-check");
  var timestampCheck = document.getElementById("timestamp-check");
  var supportNote = document.getElementById("browser-support-note");

  var port = null;
  var reader = null;
  var writer = null;
  var readableStreamClosed = null;
  var writableStreamClosed = null;
  var keepReading = false;

  function supported() {
    return "serial" in navigator;
  }

  if (supported()) {
    supportNote.textContent = "Web Serial is supported in this browser. Click Connect and pick your device.";
  } else {
    supportNote.textContent = "This browser doesn't support the Web Serial API. Use desktop Chrome or Edge.";
    connectBtn.disabled = true;
  }

  function log(text) {
    var ts = timestampCheck.checked ? "[" + new Date().toLocaleTimeString() + "] " : "";
    terminalEl.textContent += ts + text;
    if (autoscrollCheck.checked) {
      terminalEl.scrollTop = terminalEl.scrollHeight;
    }
  }

  function setConnected(isConnected) {
    connectBtn.disabled = isConnected;
    disconnectBtn.disabled = !isConnected;
    sendInput.disabled = !isConnected;
    sendBtn.disabled = !isConnected;
    baudSelect.disabled = isConnected;
    statusText.textContent = isConnected ? "Connected" : "Disconnected";
    if (isConnected) {
      statusPill.classList.add("connected");
    } else {
      statusPill.classList.remove("connected");
    }
  }

  async function readLoop() {
    try {
      while (keepReading) {
        var result = await reader.read();
        if (result.done) break;
        log(result.value);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      log("\n[read error] " + err + "\n");
    }
  }

  async function connect() {
    if (!supported()) return;
    try {
      port = await navigator.serial.requestPort();
      await port.open({ baudRate: parseInt(baudSelect.value, 10) });

      var textDecoder = new TextDecoderStream();
      readableStreamClosed = port.readable.pipeTo(textDecoder.writable);
      reader = textDecoder.readable.getReader();

      var textEncoder = new TextEncoderStream();
      writableStreamClosed = textEncoder.readable.pipeTo(port.writable);
      writer = textEncoder.writable.getWriter();

      keepReading = true;
      setConnected(true);
      log("[connected at " + baudSelect.value + " baud]\n");
      readLoop();
    } catch (err) {
      log("[connect failed] " + err + "\n");
      port = null;
    }
  }

  async function disconnect() {
    keepReading = false;
    try {
      if (reader) {
        await reader.cancel();
        await readableStreamClosed.catch(function () {});
        reader = null;
      }
      if (writer) {
        await writer.close();
        await writableStreamClosed.catch(function () {});
        writer = null;
      }
      if (port) {
        await port.close();
        port = null;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      log("[disconnect error] " + err + "\n");
    }
    setConnected(false);
    log("[disconnected]\n");
  }

  async function send() {
    if (!writer) return;
    var text = sendInput.value;
    var ending = lineEndingSelect.value;
    try {
      await writer.write(text + ending);
      log("> " + text + "\n");
      sendInput.value = "";
    } catch (err) {
      log("[send error] " + err + "\n");
    }
  }

  connectBtn.addEventListener("click", connect);
  disconnectBtn.addEventListener("click", disconnect);
  clearBtn.addEventListener("click", function () { terminalEl.textContent = ""; });
  sendBtn.addEventListener("click", send);
  sendInput.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) {
    if (e.key === "Enter") send();
  });

  if (supported() && navigator.serial) {
    navigator.serial.addEventListener("disconnect", function () {
      log("[device unplugged]\n");
      setConnected(false);
    });
  }
})();
</script>
```
